title: Tenant Settings Reference and Decision Guide
summary: A vendor-neutral reference for Microsoft Fabric tenant settings: what each controls, defaults, a recommended enterprise posture, safe enablement through security groups, and change control.
audience: Fabric administrators, security and governance leads, platform owners

pages.title: Overview and how settings work
pages.description: What tenant settings are, where to find them, how scoping, delegation and propagation work, and where each group of settings is covered.

pages.title: Decision framework and rollout
pages.description: A repeatable way to decide each setting, enable it through security groups, pilot it and keep it reviewed.

pages.title: Export and sharing settings
pages.description: Reference and recommended posture for export, sharing, guest and external collaboration settings.

pages.title: Content, models and discovery
pages.description: Reference for cross-workspace models, information protection, discovery, apps, visuals, legacy dataflows and semantic model settings.

pages.title: Integration, developer and APIs
pages.description: Reference for XMLA, Execute Queries, service principal and admin API settings, maps, single sign-on and streaming authentication.

pages.title: Workspaces, Git, OneLake and items
pages.description: Reference for Fabric item creation, workspace and recovery settings, Git integration, OneLake access, networking and encryption.

pages.title: AI, preview and experimental
pages.description: Reference for Copilot and Azure OpenAI, agents, preview item types, experiments, audit and usage settings.

pages.title: Quick reference matrix
pages.description: Every setting in one table with default, recommended posture, scoping and a link to its detail.

pages.title: Change control and troubleshooting
pages.description: Change records, snapshot-and-diff automation, audit events and a troubleshooting guide from symptom to setting.
